projects.name: SA Bank Data Quality Pipeline
projects.subtitle: Data quality and privacy
projects.summary: Data quality pipeline on synthetic SA bank data: SA ID/Luhn validation, quarantine with reasons, 8-rule fraud scoring, circuit breaker, salted SHA-256 PII masking, Delta Lake.
projects.outcome: In a run of 5,000 synthetic records with errors added on purpose, 2,278 were quarantined and 2,722 written to Delta Lake. The fraud rules haven't been tested on real labelled transactions.

projects.name: Entry-Level Job Market Pipeline
projects.subtitle: ETL and web app
projects.summary: ETL of real entry-level tech jobs from 2 APIs (Adzuna, Remotive) and a Careers24 scraper: freshness and seniority filters, upsert to PostgreSQL, Flask site and REST API, tests in GitHub Actions.
projects.outcome: Two test runs on 2 November 2026 produced 231 listings. It runs on demand, not on a schedule. Remotive added no jobs in those runs.
